rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance – source of income protection
rules.requirement: Landlords, sellers and rental agents in Cambridge may not discriminate against rental applicants based on source of income, including Section 8 vouchers and public benefits. They may select tenants by any reasonable standard applied equally to all applicants, such as ability to pay rent and ability to care for the apartment.
rules.requirement_es: En Cambridge, los propietarios, vendedores y agentes de alquiler no pueden discriminar a los solicitantes de vivienda por su fuente de ingresos, incluidos los vales de la Sección 8 y los beneficios públicos. Pueden elegir inquilinos con cualquier criterio razonable aplicado por igual a todos, como la capacidad de pagar el alquiler y de cuidar el apartamento.
rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental housing transactions in Cambridge covered by the Fair Housing Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Exemption for 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there.
rules.penalty: After a hearing, the Commission may levy civil fines of up to $300 for each violation, file a criminal complaint in District Court, seek injunctive relief, and seek damages, expenses and other relief.
rules.caveat: Secondary summary on the Human Rights Commission web page; the ordinance text and effective date are not in the document.
